features: App icon now has black padding on all sides, like Geode — the pink star sits smaller inside the black icon.
fixes: The Death Note E1 1080p Sub download that failed on dev2.19 now completes — subtitles are embedded as standard timed-text tracks instead of through the system muxer, which rejects subtitle tracks.
A subtitle problem can never fail a download anymore — if embedding fails, the download still completes with audio and video.
